scope: Composed JavaScript race with original physics, AI, contacts, bonuses and timers. A test-only route follower supplies ordinary analog controls. No poses, velocities, triggers, pickups, timers, or physics tables are changed. This is not an original Windows full-process comparison or a full-campaign UI run.
testDriverPolicy: Private closed-loop optimizer selects ordinary steering goals at original DMP nodes connected by all-rail collision-clear chords (at most12sectors, sampled on original road/land/extra ground, excluding fallback), minimizing distance plus recorded end-heading penalties; selected nodes/cost recorded. Original adjacent DMP links remain fallback edges when longer supported-ground shortcuts are unavailable. Chords are driver choices, not new game paths; original linked-road follower with its optional detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
